title: Finite truncation retaining splitting and matching data
statement: For a qcqs scheme X, a finite split étale hypercover U of X and r≥0, construct a TruncatedFiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X r whose simplicial object is the truncation of U and whose nondegenerate terms and matching objects are those of U in the retained degrees.

proof.text: Restrict all simplicial, nondegenerate and matching data. Reindex the full splitting cofan by the finite set of retained degrees and epimorphisms from the given simplex: an epimorphism forces the target degree not to exceed the source degree. The inverse reindexing inserts that bound, giving the same colimit universal property. Restrict matching cones to retained simplices and extend their indices back to the full lower-degree category; the original matching universal property supplies exactly the required lift and uniqueness.
